command:
set -eu
bad_count=$(grep -Fxc 'BROKEN SUDOERS ENTRY' /etc/sudoers)
test "$bad_count" -eq 1
backup_dir=$(mktemp -d /root/sudoers-repair.XXXXXX)
chmod 700 "$backup_dir"
cp -a /etc/sudoers "$backup_dir/sudoers.invalid"
candidate=$(mktemp /etc/.sudoers.candidate.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -f "$candidate"' 0 1 2 3 15
awk '$0 != "BROKEN SUDOERS ENTRY"' /etc/sudoers > "$candidate"
chown root:root "$candidate"
chmod 0440 "$candidate"
restorecon "$candidate"
visudo -c -f "$candidate"
cp --preserve=mode,ownership "$candidate" /etc/sudoers
restorecon /etc/sudoers
if ! visudo -c; then
  cp -a "$backup_dir/sudoers.invalid" /etc/sudoers
  restorecon /etc/sudoers
  printf 'validation failed; restored %s\n' "$backup_dir/sudoers.invalid"
  exit 1
fi
printf 'validated repair; backup=%s\n' "$backup_dir/sudoers.invalid"
